name: RS Technologies Co Ltd
summary: RS Technologies Co., Ltd. offers a comprehensive range of services and products to the global semiconductor industry, with a primary focus on reconditioning silicon wafers. The company also provides film deposition services for both new and recycled wafers, and supplies specialized wafers such as monitor, dummy, and silicon dioxide types. Diversifying its operations, it manages a solar power plant in Sanbongi and serves as an agent for ultrasonic imaging systems. Furthermore, RS Technologies delivers technical guidance and educational programs pertaining to semiconductor wafer manufacturing. Its commercial activities include distributing chemical filters essential for the semiconductor and wafer sectors, and facilitating the buying and selling of pre-owned semiconductor equipment. Founded in 1984, the company is based in Tokyo, Japan.
